Name: Korah, Son of Hebron
Summary: Son of Hebron son of Mareshah, named in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:43: Son of Hebron son of Mareshah, named in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Korah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
